objective: Create the exact remediation package required before consultant hosted resolver pilot traffic can be enabled.

sourceDecision.priorBlock: W74: Remote Resolver Pilot Toggle Decision And Consultant Smoke
sourceDecision.reason: W73R did not execute against a real remote hosted endpoint because endpoint configuration was missing.

remoteEndpointEnvSetup.name: IDB_REMOTE_RESOLVER_SMOKE
remoteEndpointEnvSetup.purpose: Explicit opt-in so remote smoke cannot run accidentally.

remoteEndpointEnvSetup.name: IDB_REMOTE_RESOLVER_BASE_URL
remoteEndpointEnvSetup.purpose: Public remote staging websiteResolverServiceV1 base URL.
remoteEndpointEnvSetup.validation: Must be HTTPS and must not be localhost, loopback, private network, or metadata IP.

remoteEndpointEnvSetup.name: IDB_REMOTE_RESOLVER_TOKEN
remoteEndpointEnvSetup.purpose: Resolver API token sent by test harness and drawer adapter placeholder.
remoteEndpointEnvSetup.validation: Must be configured from protected environment or secret manager and redacted from all traces/reports.

remoteEndpointEnvSetup.name: IDB_REMOTE_RESOLVER_ALLOWED_ORIGIN
remoteEndpointEnvSetup.purpose: Approved NetSuite staging origin for CORS preflight and hosted drawer requests.
remoteEndpointEnvSetup.validation: Approved OPTIONS preflight returns allow-origin matching this exact origin.

remoteEndpointEnvSetup.name: IDB_REMOTE_RESOLVER_BLOCKED_ORIGIN
remoteEndpointEnvSetup.validation: Blocked OPTIONS preflight fails and does not echo the blocked origin.

secretHandlingChecklist: Do not commit resolver tokens to repo files, README, reports, trace samples, screenshots, or shell history snippets.
Use a secret manager, protected CI variable, or local shell export outside the repository.
Only record tokenConfigured true or false in traces.
Never print Authorization, cookie, or X-IDB-Resolver-Token raw values.
Reject inbound cookie/auth-header shaped browser session payloads at the resolver endpoint.
Rotate the staging token before moving from internal smoke to consultant pilot.

approved: Use the exact NetSuite staging account origin.
Do not use wildcard production CORS.
Do not allow arbitrary consultant-entered website origins.
Allow POST and OPTIONS only for the resolver endpoint.
blocked: Use a known unapproved HTTPS origin for negative smoke.
Verify blocked origin gets no allow-origin echo.
Verify blocked origin cannot reach fetch logic.
Keep CORS rejection separate from URL blocked/thin/unavailable/timeout failure states.

tasks: Deploy the W69 endpoint wrapper or equivalent hosted service.
Confirm cache adapter is enabled for staging.
Confirm timeout and page-size controls match W62/W63.
Run approved live-site smoke through the hosted endpoint.
Verify evidence coverage, source URLs, status, and failure states.
Run W73R with remote config present.
Confirm zero false-confident-wrong and zero unsupported claims.
Confirm hosted pilot toggle remains disabled until W73R passes.
After W73R passes, run the hosted-only consultant smoke.
Verify Plan/Review/ROI/Run/Trace show concise resolver status and rollback guidance.
Confirm no repeated audit detail crowds the live consultant view.

noSecretTraceRules: Trace may include baseUrlConfigured but not the raw base URL when not needed for operator action.
Trace may include tokenConfigured but never token value.
Trace may include allowedOriginConfigured and blockedOriginConfigured booleans.
Report must never include request headers containing token, cookie, or Authorization values.
pilotUnlockCriteria: Remote /health confirms writeAuthority none, suiteScriptInvocation false, and nllmAdvisoryOnly true.
Approved CORS passes with exact allowed origin.
Blocked CORS fails with no blocked-origin echo.
Second eligible resolve returns cacheHit true.
Approved live-site smoke passes with zero false-confident-wrong.
Approved live-site smoke passes with zero unsupported claims.
Blocked/thin/unavailable/timeout sites return insufficient evidence with no confident lane guesses.
Full preflight passes after W73R remote execution.
W74 can be rerun and returns hosted resolver consultant smoke eligible.
memoryPoints: Do not treat W72 readiness, W73 blocked gate, W73R blocked gate, or W74 no-go as proof that a hosted endpoint works.
Only W73R with remoteSmokeExecuted true can unlock hosted resolver consultant smoke.
Website evidence remains identity authority; notes remain story-only.
No write authority changes are part of hosted resolver remediation.

bestNextCodexPrompt.block: W76: Hosted Resolver Configured Remote Execution
bestNextCodexPrompt.prompt: Move through W76: Hosted Resolver Configured Remote Execution. After the W75 remediation pack has been applied, run W73R with the real remote staging websiteResolverServiceV1 endpoint configuration present. Execute health, auth/CORS, write-payload rejection, cache-hit, approved live-site smoke, no-secret trace checks, full preflight, and pilot unlock criteria. Keep drawer and SuiteScript write-disabled, preserve N/LLM advisory-only, notes story-only, and blocked/thin/unavailable/timeout as insufficient evidence with no confident guesses. Output executed remote results, pilot unlock or no-go decision, trace samples, W76 report, validator gates, and best next Codex prompt.
